purpose: Signal-first confirmation of an already-started >=10-session decline. No advance-warning objective.
inputs: Reuse verified immutable 7426-stock inventory and 7237 usable price/feature/L1 caches from downtrend-indicators-20261021. Preserve price adjustments, gaps, lambda=1, slope threshold +/-1e-6. No live collection.

periods.test: 2023-04-01 through 2025-09-30; retrospective L1 through 2026-09-30; previously examined historical period, NOT untouched test
periods.all: all available dates; descriptive, overlaps train/test

eligibility: 65 prior and126 subsequent same-segment bars, finite L1 at t and t+126, finite directional edge. All censored DOWN runs excluded from label assessment, not called short declines. Indicator missing separately excluded. No restriction to downward days. Fixed future buffer also permits all 5/21/63-session paths on a common sample.
target: Completed DOWN runs >=10 edges; first edge date is day0; early age0..5 inclusive SIX dates. Day0 and days1..5 separate. Sensitivities age0..3 and age0..10 restricted to days actually inside the run. Duration10..20/21..62/63+ secondary only.
signals: Original63 causal event definitions unchanged. New entries/crossings counted once at occurrence; distinct later recrossings are distinct signals. Candle/day-specific patterns may recur on consecutive days. Never deduplicate using L1 truth.
classification: All evaluable signal days partition into target early, >=10-day run late, completed <10-day down run, and other (up/flat). Pre-onset signals stay in denominator as other.
comparison: One stock-day is the unit for BOTH ordinary and early rates. Ordinary=UP or FLAT; late/short separately. Same-stock/calendar-quarter/three observable context bits (MA20 rising over5 days, close>MA20, RSI>=60) comparison to non-signal days, standardized to signal distribution on supported strata. Association, not causal effect.
selection: Before TEST reranking, TRAIN only: exclude control family, require >=500 signals, >=100 signal stocks, >=10% episode capture, <=20 signals/252 evaluable sessions. Select highest precision, then highest capture among remaining candidates with precision >=80% of highest. No threshold tuning. If none eligible, no candidate. Save TRAIN table and frozen IDs before TEST stage.
extensions: For each of two selected bases per market, three predeclared variants: base event AND close<MA20 on same day; first close/MA20 downward cross within0..5 sessions after base; first confirmation of3 consecutive closes<MA20 within0..5 after base, requiring all3 days on/after base. Emit actual confirmation day, once per armed base; new base rearms. Segment gaps reset. No hindsight backdating. Six variants/market, all retained regardless of result.
metrics: Signal precision central; marginal95% two-way cluster multiplier bootstrap CI, day0/1..5, daily concentration difference/ratio, context adjustment/support, equal-stock precision, yearly, episode capture, first-confirmation lag, annual frequency. Onset close to next same-segment open drop; next open as path origin; lows/highs and final close over next5/21/63 bars. Excursions are NOT executable profits or avoided losses.
uncertainty: TEST stock/calendar-quarter crossed Poisson multiplier bootstrap1000 seeded21021. Precision, daily concentration difference and contextual improvement. Bonferroni family adjusted normal bounds/p across all69 conditions x2 markets x2 association tests (276), with bootstrap standard errors; pointwise precision intervals are not simultaneous ranking guarantees. Correlation reflected by stock and time clusters; finite quarters remain a limitation.
endpoint_sensitivity: Deterministic SHA256-selected 40 stocks/market with sufficient continuous history: refit L1 at2020,2021,2023,2024 year ends and compare with longer available fit, onset matching within5 sessions and recent126-day labels. Also compare TRAIN-cutoff labels against full-sample labels on2016-2021. Report unmatched/shifted starts and signal-label disagreement by distance from cutoff. Endpoint fits use exactly prefix prices.
reliability: No claim of untouched prospective verification because both prior TEST and full-history data have been inspected. Fixed temporal assessment and frozen TRAIN selection reduce but do not erase researcher adaptation. Current-listing survivorship and source adjustment limitations retained. No operational changes.
